packageRules.description: The contract package is the API's public surface: never auto-merge, label it, and keep it out of the non-major group so a bump is reviewed on its own. Renovate needs a hostRule for npm.pkg.github.com (token with read:packages) to see new versions.
Auto-merge dev tooling only. Runtime dependencies of the Lambda always get a human review: main auto-deploys, so an auto-merged compromised package would ship itself.
